description: Angular component for a time window configuration panel in the Thingsboard UI, managing time window selection, validation, and dialog interactions.

classes.name: TimewindowPanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing a configurable time window panel, including form controls, dialog interactions, and validation logic.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form and component state based on input data, sets up value change subscriptions.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions on component destruction.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Updates form validators based on the selected aggregation type.

methods.name: onTimewindowTypeChange
methods.description: Handles changes in the time window type, updating form values accordingly.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Prepares and emits the current time window configuration.

methods.name: prepareTimewindowConfig
methods.description: Constructs a Timewindow object from form values, optionally clearing config.

methods.name: updateTimewindowForm
methods.description: Updates form controls based on the current Timewindow object.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Disposes of the overlay dialog without saving changes.

methods.name: openTimewindowConfig
methods.description: Opens a dialog for advanced time window configuration.

methods.name: updateTimewindowAdvancedParams
methods.description: Updates internal parameters related to advanced time window options.

methods.name: minRealtimeAggInterval
methods.description: Returns minimum allowed realtime aggregation interval.

methods.name: maxRealtimeAggInterval
methods.description: Returns maximum allowed realtime aggregation interval.

methods.name: currentRealtimeTimewindow
methods.description: Calculates current realtime time window value from form.

methods.name: minHistoryAggInterval
methods.description: Returns minimum allowed history aggregation interval.

methods.name: maxHistoryAggInterval
methods.description: Returns maximum allowed history aggregation interval.

methods.name: currentHistoryTimewindow
methods.description: Calculates current history time window value from form.
